description: Publish a website on OxyPages with no account and get a live HTTPS link. The link lasts 30 minutes unless the user claims it into a free account with claim_url. Up to 25 MB and 10 files. Send either html (one complete page) or files (several files, index.html at the top level). HTML, CSS, JS and images (SVG included, as plain images) - no PDF. For a framework app (React, Vue, Vite, Astro...), run its build and use deploy_app with the output folder instead, when deploy_app is listed. After publishing, give the user url, tell them it expires in 30 minutes, and give them claim_url to keep it. FILES FROM DISK: these tools carry every byte inline, which suits HTML, CSS, JS and a few small images. For photos, screenshots or anything over a few hundred KB, do not send base64: if you can run commands, run `npx oxypages --temporary <folder>` (no account, same 30-minute claim link) or, better for anything the user wants to keep, sign in and upload into their account. Personal or private content (family photos, reports about people) should not go to a public no-account link at all: tell the user to publish it from their account with a password.

files.description: The complete file set, including index.html at the top level. Use this OR html.

encoding.description: utf8 for text (the default), base64 for images.

path.description: Site-relative path, e.g. index.html or css/style.css.

html.description: One complete HTML document, served as index.html. Use this OR files.

name: publish_page
title: Publish a page on OxyPages
